##### Project general facts

Listone Residence is a residential building by Lion Stone Properties in International City, designed around the idea of affordable luxury and smart living. The project offers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments with practical layouts, with selected one-bedroom units and all two-bedroom units including an additional flexible room that can be adapted to different needs.

The amenity offer is designed for an active and social lifestyle. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool and a kids' pool, an indoor gym and an indoor yoga studio, as well as padel, badminton and table tennis courts and a jogging track. A children's playground, a barbecue area, an outdoor cinema and an outdoor events area create spaces for families and friends to gather.

Apartments are delivered fully furnished, with branded kitchen appliances, a smart home system and generous ceiling heights, creating a ready-to-live home with a modern and comfortable feel.
    
##### Location description and benefits

International City is a well-established residential district in Dubai, known for its multicultural character and practical, self-contained urban planning. The area offers everyday convenience with supermarkets, restaurants, clinics, schools and community parks within walking distance, making it a practical choice for families and working professionals.

Dragon Mart and the Dubai Fruit and Vegetable Market are within a short drive, while Dubai Safari Park and Dubai Creek Harbour are also close by. Direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Ras Al Khor Road connects residents to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of accessible pricing, steady rental demand from families and professionals and convenient road connections positions the area for both end users and investors seeking practical apartment living in Dubai.
